creator.title: My games
creator.subtitle: Send your games to the moderation team, follow the review and fix what they ask for.
creator.newSubmissionHelp: Host your build anywhere (itch.io, GitHub Pages, your own server) and give us the link. Moderators play that exact link.
creator.step1: Upload your game with a playable link and a short description.
creator.step2: A platform moderator plays it and leaves comments if something needs changing.
creator.step3: You fix it, ship a new version and resubmit.
creator.step4: When it's approved, the platform owner adds it to the catalogue and everyone can play it.
